missing_samples.policy: reject by default; explicit contiguous segments or recorded interpolation only

nan.rejection: Require >=16 finite phase samples in seconds; missing samples must be rejected or explicitly segmented/imputed

missing_timestamps.rejection: Nonuniform/missing/duplicate timestamps; do not compress time

duplicate_timestamp.rejection: Nonuniform/missing/duplicate timestamps; do not compress time

timelab_raw_nan_probe.interpretation: diagnostic only; not an endorsed missing-data estimator; production guard rejects raw NaNs

missing_samples.probe_prefix_cleanup: removed temporary clone after targeted wineserver shutdown

capability.nonoverlap TimeLab: N/A documented interface lacks a separate mode

discrepancy_diagnosis.policy: No authority assumed. Inspect each TimeLab/AllanTools/Decimal triple. All numerical failures remain FAIL; tolerances are never relaxed automatically.
